title: Transport

content:
Clock module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) based on the Ableton Link object [abl_lnk~] with elements from clockswingx, with start/stop (aux) reset (C1) and record functions (controls Capture and Cassette), with a minimal UI, a "signature" setting (sending a bang for modules on reset), swing 8,16 and jitter settings with visual feedbacks on one page :

aux : start/stop
C1 : reset (controls Transport and Cassette modules)
C#1 : record (if playing) or arm recording (controls Capture and Cassette modules)
notes from D to A#2 : time signature
B2 : MIDI out

start/stop and signature functions are compatible with some other modules (Capture, Cassette, Cycles, Grids, Sequences, ...)

#1 copy transport_1-3.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install transport_1-3..."

(will be installed into /media/orac/usermodules/utility)

v1.4 : major MIDI and Link sync bugfixes and improvements, Jitter (knob4) replaced by Chaos (jitter+drift)

v1.3 : now only working from the Ableton Link object, output sends renamed (s start, s stop, s reset, s record, s arm-record, for controling modules, instead of s midi-start, s midi-stop, ... as i added first), other minor improvements

v1.2 : repatching of the module based on the Ableton Link PD object still based on clockswingx, major UI improvements, timeline added (resets on every start)

v1.1 : UI bugfix
